rows.grounds: indeclinable adverb indicating separation or distinction
past passive participle from root kṛ, describing the separated elements
demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously mentioned elements
optative verb expressing a ritual injunction
compound object denoting the series or garland of syllables

items.question: How should the alphabet-garland be formed after separating its elements?
premises: The elements have been made separate by them.
A ritual action of making is prescribed.
The object to be made is the alphabet-garland.
items.inference: One should especially form the alphabet-garland by arranging those separately made elements.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taiḥ depends on the preceding ritual context.
items.plain_english: Having made them separate, one should especially form the alphabet-garland.
